rubric.completeness: 1 no answer; 2 few necessary points; 3 main points with clear omissions; 4 most points; 5 all answerable points, with justified abstention for unavailable evidence
rubric.faithfulness: 1 serious error; 2 multiple clear errors; 3 mostly grounded with some errors; 4 minor issues; 5 all important facts directly supported
rubric.relevance: 1 off topic; 5 directly answers all requested parts; intermediate scores require source review
rubric.citation_support: Validity, correct source attribution, and semantic support are separate; numerical score requires claim-level review

rule: No semantic status or 1-5 score is inferred from citation presence, token overlap, answer length, or heuristic warnings. Unreviewed claims remain Unverified.
review_provenance: Codex assisted source-text review is not independent human blind review
